scope: Regression of integrated synchronous trap acceptance, CSR effects and mtvec redirect using the shared head_system_controller. This profile exercises integer/control-flow/frontend faults only; fetched CSR/MRET execution is covered by system_core. No LSU, interrupts, full architectural-suite acceptance or physical timing claim.
faults: Raw head faults are prepared by head_system_controller and csr_unit. Trap output is a separate valid/ready architectural event channel, mutually exclusive with ordinary retirement. Only trap_valid_o && trap_ready_i increments ROB order, applies CSR state, restores committed rename state, clears ROB/IQ and both producer holders, and redirects to direct mtvec. A held proposal is stable; cancellation discards it. Raw backend_fault_event_o remains diagnostic and must not be reported as an accepted event.
recovery: Reset wins. External flush_i cancels a prepared trap and supplies the restart target without resetting CSR state or architectural order. Fatal state cancels the proposal and suppresses architectural progress. With a fault at the ROB head, younger branch resolutions are withheld even while trap output is stalled. A younger branch may resolve before the older fault reaches the head; its recovery preserves older work. Accepted trap redirect has frontend capacity and takes priority over branch recovery. Offered fetch requests remain stable, and already accepted stale responses drain before target fetch.
flow: FRONTEND_FAULTS=1 and TRAP_SERVICE=1 select the shared CSR/MRET/trap controller in the production core. This regression does not dispatch CSR/MRET, so mtvec remains its reset value 0x100. The system_core profile covers CSR writes, MRET and programmable handler targets. Raw-fault and historical execution profiles disable TRAP_SERVICE.
drain: The core recycles ROB identities itself. On identity_drain_o it stops new fetch demand, waits until the window is empty, no instruction transaction is offered or outstanding, no producer, system or memory work is held and flush_ready_o is high, restart-flushes to the committed next PC (last retired or trap pc_after, else the last external flush PC or reset PC), then pulses the internal drain. identity_drain_o falls when the recycle completes. External drained_i remains legal under the same conditions with enable_i low; generations never silently wrap.
